Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/edadismo ; microdata deposit https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/13445864/MD3493.zip (md5 d84e87d65056d8ceac4d31ccbced1bc0) containing 3493.sav (variable labels P5_1..P5_4; value labels labels20-labels23) and 3493_num.csv; questionnaire https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/13445864/cues3493.pdf (block [P5] under P.5, p.4); published marginals es3493mar-pdf.pdf, Pregunta 5; ficha tecnica FT3493.pdf. Processing script data/spain_2025_ageism.do, Bookmark 2: agreement. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the CIS microdata deposit MD3493.zip (md5 d84e87d65056d8ceac4d31ccbced1bc0) ships 3493.sav, whose VARIABLE labels tie each source column to its statement verbatim -- P5_1 'Los/as jovenes actualmente tienen muchas mas oportunidades de las que tuvieron sus padres a su edad', P5_2 'Las personas mayores por lo general, sufren mas soledad que las jovenes', P5_3 'Deberia limitarse la edad para renovar o tener el carnet de conducir', P5_4 'Los/as jovenes no son capaces de divertirse sin dispositivos tecnologicos' -- and whose VALUE labels (labels20-labels23, all four identical) tie the codes to the anchors 1 'Muy de acuerdo', 2 'De acuerdo', 3 '(NO LEER) Regular (ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo)', 4 'En desacuerdo', 5 'Muy en desacuerdo', 8 'N.S.', 9 'N.C.'. All four statements were compared character-for-character (Python string equality) against the [P5] grid under P.5 of the questionnaire cues3493.pdf and are identical, in the same order; they are also the row labels of Pregunta 5 in the published marginals es3493mar.pdf. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2025_ageism.do imports 3493_num.csv (semicolon-delimited, varnames(1) case(preserve)), recovers the mangled headers from the Stata variable labels, runs 'rename *, lower', and in Bookmark 2 loops 'gen item = "`var'"' over the literal list p5_1 p5_2 p5_3 p5_4 -- the IRW item code IS the source column name lowercased. Nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt under the derivation rule and no verification_*.csv / verify_*.R was written. CHECKED ANYWAY AND DECISIVELY, with no Redivis export: applying the do-file's own filter (codes 3, 8 and 9 set to missing, i.e. resp in {1,2,4,5}) to 3493_num.csv gives per-column n of P5_1 4925, P5_2 4944, P5_3 4827, P5_4 4919, and irw::irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) returns exactly 4925 / 4944 / 4827 / 4919 for p5_1..p5_4, summing to 19615 = the live n_rows it reports. The four counts are MUTUALLY DISTINCT, so the count check distinguishes every item from every other item and no permutation of the four statements is consistent with the data. Full source cell counts for the record (N=5006 respondents): P5_1 1:603 2:1704 3:48 4:1906 5:712 8:19 9:14; P5_2 1:2119 2:2405 3:29 4:358 5:62 8:21 9:12; P5_3 1:1106 2:2004 3:53 4:1376 5:341 8:66 9:60; P5_4 1:1335 2:1845 3:38 4:1485 5:254 8:35 9:14. text_source=study_materials: the Spanish in instructions, item_text and option_text is transcribed from CIS's own questionnaire and the .sav labels. instructions is the complete P.5 carrier question verbatim; unlike several Estudio 3497 siblings it carries NO trailing interviewer direction, so none was dropped and none was added. section_prompt is blank with one trivial section_id -- P.5 is a single flat grid with no testlet structure. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes no English version of Estudio 3493, so the English in the four _translated columns was produced by IRW. RESP SET: live {1,2,4,5}. Code 3, the not-read-aloud volunteered midpoint '(NO LEER) Regular (ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo)' (168 of 20024 source cells: 48/29/53/38), is dropped to missing by the .do file alongside 8 (N.S.) and 9 (N.C.), so the non-contiguous resp set is by design and no option row is shipped for 3, 8 or 9. Nothing was padded: every shipped option_text is the source's own anchor wording. STEP 3b: study 3493 is 'EDADISMO' (Ageism), CIS ficha tecnica FT3493.pdf, CATI fieldwork 10-16 January 2025, 5006 interviews -- a DIFFERENT study from Estudio 3497 'Calidad de la democracia (III)' extracted in batch_294, confirmed from the study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/edadismo. The dictionary Description 'Agreement with statements about generational differences' matches the [P5] block exactly (youth opportunities vs their parents', loneliness in old age, a driving-licence age limit, youth and technology), and the live item codes are literally p5_1..p5_4, so there is no instrument mismatch. The same study supplies nine sibling IRW tables from other questions (P1/P2 problems, P6 elderpriority, P7 youthpriority, P11 elderslights, P12/P13 and later blocks for youthslights, comparison, difficulty, bureaucracy); ONLY the P5 block was extracted here. RIGHTS: no block, verified independently for study 3493 rather than inherited from the 3497 round. The wording's originator is CIS itself, a Spanish public body that publishes the questionnaire; its reuse conditions (https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis, fetched 2026-09-20, page sha256 1d79e49e0a783b92189b750dfc6061c5f31bc33d341423245d617413c4e062b3) grant a positive right rather than reserving one: 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'La reutilizacion autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusion, modificacion, adaptacion, extraccion, reordenacion y combinacion de la informacion', with an explicit 'cesion gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual', under Ley 37/2007. The only conditions are non-distortion of the information, attribution ('Origen de los datos: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas'), mentioning the date of last update, and no claim of CIS endorsement -- none of which is a reserved right of the kind irw#1945 blocks on. The 3493 study page itself states no study-specific restriction, only a link to these same general conditions. No instrument_rights_register.csv row was written: a round may never write a ship row, so this CIS-family ship verdict is escalated to the human.
public_note: The English item, instruction and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes Estudio 3493 in Spanish only; the administered Spanish is in the base fields. Note also that the response values run 1, 2, 4, 5 with no option row for 3: respondents could volunteer a middle 'Regular (ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo)' answer (CIS code 3, not read aloud) which the IRW processing script drops to missing along with 8 'N.S.' and 9 'N.C.'.

Microdata package https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3497 (3497.sav variable and value labels; 3497_num.csv); questionnaire https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/cues3497 P.2 [P2], P.7 [P7], P.11 [P11]; published marginals https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/es3497mar-pdf. Processing script data/spain_2025_democracy.do (Bookmark 1: system). Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizacion-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels. Unlike its batch_293/294 siblings this table is NOT one grid: data/spain_2025_democracy.do Bookmark 1 stacks THREE standalone single questions -- p2, p7, p11 -- into one long file ('local survey_cols p2 p7 p11'). 3497.sav's variable labels tie each column to its content outright (P2 'Sentimiento de orgullo de los espanoles por el proceso de la transicion a la democracia'; P7 'Suficiencia de los mecanismos actuales del sistema democratico ante la corrupcion politica'; P11 'Consideracion de la necesidad de crear/ampliar nuevas formas de participacion ciudadana en asuntos y decisiones politicas'), and the questionnaire cues3497.pdf prints the administered wording of each under the bracket tag naming that very column ([P2], [P7], [P11]) -- so the tie is a label match at two independent levels, not an order inference. The words shipped in item_text are the questionnaire's administered wording, transcribed verbatim (the .sav labels are catalogue descriptions, not what the interviewer read). Derivation is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do file imports 3497_num.csv, does 'rename *, lower', and sets item = the column name, so p2/p7/p11 ARE the source columns -- Step 5b exempt, no verification_*.csv or verify_*.R written. Checked against the data anyway and decisively: applying the do-file's own filters (p2 drops codes 3/8/9; p7 and p11 drop 8/9) to 3497_num.csv gives per-column n of P2=3854, P7=3981, P11=3979 (total 11,814), reproducing the live per-item n from irw::irw_table_sets() exactly -- p2 3854, p7 3981, p11 3979, n_rows 11,814 -- and the three counts are mutually distinct, so every item is distinguished from every other. Structural deviation from the siblings, deliberate: because the three questions share no carrier stem, instructions and section_prompt are both NA and the full question wording sits in item_text, with a single trivial section_id. Response coding: all three are Si/No items; the .sav value labels give 1 'Si', 2 'No', 8 'N.S.', 9 'N.C.', plus a P2-only volunteered 3 '(NO LEER) Le es indiferente'. The do-file drops 3 (P2 only), 8 and 9, so the live resp set is {1,2} and no option row is shipped for 3/8/9; only 9 of 4,010 P2 cells were on code 3. One transcription note: cues3497.pdf prints the P.11 affirmative anchor as 'Si' without the accent while P.2 and P.7 print 'Si' accented; the shipped option_text uses the accented 'Si' from 3497.sav's value labels for all three. The English in the four _translated columns was produced by IRW -- CIS publishes no English version of Estudio 3497 -- so translation_source=machine_translation and an issues-page entry is owed once the table is live.
public_note: The English item, option and question text for this table was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish that CIS actually administered in Estudio 3497; the administered Spanish is the authoritative text and sits in the base columns.

public_note: Respondents answered on an 0-10 trust scale on which only the endpoints were labelled ('Ninguna confianza' at 0, 'Total confianza' at 10), so option_text is deliberately blank for resp 1-9 rather than repeating the numeral; the codes 98 'N.S.' and 99 'N.C.' are dropped to missing by the IRW processing script and have no option row; and the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only.
